decision: Site survey: verify room, wall build-up, all openings and finished datums.
Door supplier: confirm handing, frame, actual leaf and clear opening; check use and circulation.
Electrical trade: develop circuiting, loads, protection, routes and mounting details for proposed points.
Joiner: select hinges, overlays, door heights, drilling, shelf supports and joints before shop drawings.
Site/joiner: establish wall substrate, anchors, load criteria, plinth leveling and restraints.
Designer/client: approve veneer/lacquer, grain, edge samples, sheen and all selected fixtures.
